items.source: visible - true if the annotation is visible at runtime.
items.translation: visible - 如果注解在运行时可见，则为 true。

a visitor to visit the annotation values, or null if this visitor is not
    interested in visiting this annotation.
items.translation: 访问该注解值的访客，或者如果此访客对该注解不感兴趣则为 null。

items.source: Constructs a new MethodVisitor.
items.translation: 构造一个新的MethodVisitor。

items.source: typePath - the path to the annotated type argument, wildcard bound, array element type, or static inner type within 'typeRef'. May be null if the annotation targets 'typeRef' as a whole.
items.translation: `typePath` - 在 `typeRef` 内到注解类型参数、通配符边界、数组元素类型或静态内部类型的路径。如果注解针对整个 `typeRef`，则可能为 null。

items.source: The method visitor to which this visitor must delegate method calls. May be null.
items.translation: 该访问者必须向其委派方法调用的方法。可为 null。

items.source: Visits a method instruction. A method instruction is an instruction that invokes a method.
items.translation: 访问方法指令。方法指令是调用方法的指令。

items.source: descriptor - the method's descriptor (see Type).
items.translation: descriptor - 方法的描述符（参见Type）。

items.source: opcode - the opcode of the type instruction to be visited. This opcode is either INVOKEVIRTUAL, INVOKESPECIAL, INVOKESTATIC or INVOKEINTERFACE.
items.translation: opcode - 要访问的类型指令的操作码。此操作码为 INVOKEVIRTUAL、INVOKESPECIAL、INVOKESTATIC 或 INVOKEINTERFACE 之一。

items.source: name - the method's name.
items.translation: name - 方法名。

items.source: dflt - beginning of the default handler block.
items.translation: dflt - 默认处理程序块的开始。

items.source:
Visits the current state of the local variables and operand stack elements. This method must(*) be called just before any instruction i that follows an unconditional branch instruction such as GOTO or THROW, that is the target of a jump instruction, or that starts an exception handler block. The visited types must describe the values of the local variables and of the operand stack elements just before i is executed.

(*) this is mandatory only for classes whose version is greater than or equal to Opcodes.V1_6.

The frames of a method must be given either in expanded form, or in compressed form (all frames must use the same format, i.e. you must not mix expanded and compressed frames within a single method):
  • In expanded form, all frames must have the F_NEW type.
  • In compressed form, frames are basically "deltas" from the state of the previous frame:
    • Opcodes.F_SAME representing frame with exactly the same locals as the previous frame and with the empty stack.
    • Opcodes.F_SAME1 representing frame with exactly the same locals as the previous frame and with single value on the stack ( numStack is 1 and stack[0] contains value for the type of the stack item).
    • Opcodes.F_APPEND representing frame with current locals are the same as the locals in the previous frame, except that additional locals are defined ( numLocal is 1, 2 or 3 and local elements contains values representing added types).
    • Opcodes.F_CHOP representing frame with current locals are the same as the locals in the previous frame, except that the last 1-3 locals are absent and with the empty stack (numLocal is 1, 2 or 3).
    • Opcodes.F_FULL representing complete frame data.

In both cases the first frame, corresponding to the method's parameters and access flags, is implicit and must not be visited. Also, it is illegal to visit two or more frames for the same code location (i.e., at least one instruction must be visited between two calls to visitFrame).
items.translation:
访问局部变量和运算栈元素当前状态的方法。此方法必须(*)在无条件分支指令（如 GOTO 或 THROW）之后的任何指令i、跳转指令的目标指令，或异常处理程序块起始指令之前立即调用。访问的类型必须描述在i执行之前的局部变量和运算栈元素的值。

(*) 此要求仅适用于版本大于或等于 Opcodes.V1_6 的类。

方法帧必须以扩展形式或压缩形式给出（所有帧必须使用相同的格式，即不能在单个方法中混合使用扩展和压缩帧）：
  • 在扩展形式中，所有帧都必须具有 F_NEW 类型。
  • 在压缩形式中，帧基本上是相对于前一帧状态的“增量”：
    • Opcodes.F_SAME 表示与前一帧具有完全相同的局部变量且栈为空的帧。
    • Opcodes.F_SAME1 表示与前一帧具有完全相同的局部变量且栈上只有一个值的帧（numStack 为 1，stack[0] 包含栈项类型的值）。
    • Opcodes.F_APPEND 表示当前局部变量与前一帧相同，但定义了额外的局部变量（numLocal 为 1、2 或 3，local 元素包含表示添加类型的值）。
    • Opcodes.F_CHOP 表示当前局部变量与前一帧相同，但最后 1-3 个局部变量不存在且栈为空（numLocal 为 1、2 或 3）。
    • Opcodes.F_FULL 表示完整的帧数据。

在这两种情况下，第一个帧（对应于方法的参数和访问标志）是隐式的，不得对其进行访问。此外，对于同一代码位置访问两个或更多帧是非法的（即，在两次调用 visitFrame 之间必须至少访问一条指令）。

items.source: A visitor to visit a Java method. The methods of this class must be called in the following order: ( visitParameter )* [ visitAnnotationDefault ] ( visitAnnotation | visitAnnotableParameterCount | visitParameterAnnotation | visitTypeAnnotation | visitAttribute )* [ visitCode ( visitFrame | visit<i>X</i>Insn | visitLabel | visitInsnAnnotation | visitTryCatchBlock | visitTryCatchAnnotation | visitLocalVariable | visitLocalVariableAnnotation | visitLineNumber | visitAttribute )* visitMaxs ] visitEnd. In addition, the visit<i>X</i>Insn and visitLabel methods must be called in the sequential order of the bytecode instructions of the visited code, visitInsnAnnotation must be called after the annotated instruction, visitTryCatchBlock must be called before the labels passed as arguments have been visited, visitTryCatchBlockAnnotation must be called after the corresponding try catch block has been visited, and the visitLocalVariable, visitLocalVariableAnnotation and visitLineNumber methods must be called after the labels passed as arguments have been visited. Finally, the visitAttribute method must be called before visitCode for non-code attributes, and after it for code attributes.
items.translation: 访问者用于访问 Java 方法。此类的各个方法必须按以下顺序调用：( visitParameter )* [ visitAnnotationDefault ] ( visitAnnotation | visitAnnotableParameterCount | visitParameterAnnotation | visitTypeAnnotation | visitAttribute )* [ visitCode ( visitFrame | visit<i>X</i>Insn | visitLabel | visitInsnAnnotation | visitTryCatchBlock | visitTryCatchAnnotation | visitLocalVariable | visitLocalVariableAnnotation | visitLineNumber | visitAttribute )* visitMaxs ] visitEnd。此外，visit<i>X</i>Insn 和 visitLabel 方法必须按照被访问代码的字节码指令顺序调用；visitInsnAnnotation 必须在被注解的指令之后调用；visitTryCatchBlock 必须在作为参数传递的标签被访问之前调用；visitTryCatchBlockAnnotation 必须在对应的 try-catch 块被访问之后调用；而 visitLocalVariable、visitLocalVariableAnnotation 和 visitLineNumber 方法必须在作为参数传递的标签被访问之后调用。最后，对于非代码属性，visitAttribute 方法必须在 visitCode 之前调用；而对于代码属性，则必须在 visitCode 之后调用。

items.source: Visits an annotation on an exception handler type. This method must be called after the visitTryCatchBlock(Label, Label, Label, String) for the annotated exception handler. It can be called several times for the same exception handler.
items.translation: 访问异常处理器类型上的注解。此方法必须在已标注的异常处理程序调用visitTryCatchBlock(Label, Label, Label, String)之后调用。它可以针对同一个异常处理程序被多次调用。

items.source: Visits a type instruction. A type instruction is an instruction that takes the internal name of a class as parameter (see Type.getInternalName()).
items.translation: 访问类型指令。类型指令是指以类的内部名称为参数的指令（参见Type.getInternalName()）。

items.source: Visits an annotation on an instruction. This method must be called just after the annotated instruction. It can be called several times for the same instruction.
items.translation: 访问指令上的注解。此方法必须在被注解的指令之后立即调用。对于同一指令，可以多次调用此方法。

items.source: The method visitor to which this visitor must delegate method calls.
items.translation: 该访问者必须委托方法调用的目标访问者方法。

items.source: Visits an annotation of this method.
items.translation: 访问此方法的注解。

items.source: Visits the default value of this annotation interface method.
items.translation: 访问此注解接口方法的默认值。

items.source: Visits a non standard attribute of this method.
items.translation: 访问此方法的非标准属性。

items.source: Visits an IINC instruction.
items.translation: 访问 IINC 指令。

items.source: Visits a zero operand instruction.
items.translation: 访问零操作数指令。

items.source: Visits an instruction with a single int operand.
items.translation: 访问具有单个 int 操作数的指令。

items.source: Visits an invokedynamic instruction.
items.translation: 访问 invokedynamic 指令。

items.source: Visits a line number declaration.
items.translation: 访问行号声明。

items.source: Visits a local variable declaration.
items.translation: 访问局部变量声明。

items.source: Visits an annotation on a local variable type.
items.translation: 访问本地变量类型上的注解。

items.source: Visits a LOOKUPSWITCH instruction.
items.translation: 访问 LOOKUPSWITCH 指令。

items.source: Visits the maximum stack size and the maximum number of local variables of the method.
items.translation: 访问方法的堆栈最大大小和局部变量最大数量。

items.source: Visits a MULTIANEWARRAY instruction.
items.translation: 访问 MULTIANEWARRAY 指令。

items.source: Visits a parameter of this method.
items.translation: 访问此方法的参数。

items.source: Visits an annotation of a parameter this method.
items.translation: 访问此方法的参数的注解。

items.source: Visits a TABLESWITCH instruction.
items.translation: 访问 TABLESWITCH 指令。

items.source: Visits a try catch block.
items.translation: 访问 try-catch 块。

items.source: Visits an annotation on a type in the method signature.
items.translation: 访问方法签名中类型上的注解。

items.source:
Visits the number of method parameters that can have annotations. By default (i.e. when this
method is not called), all the method parameters defined by the method descriptor can have
annotations.
items.translation: 访问可以具有注解的方法参数的数量。默认情况下（即未调用此方法时），由方法描述符定义的所有方法参数都可以具有注解。

items.source: Starts the visit of the method's code, if any (i.e. non abstract method).
items.translation: 启动方法代码的访问（如果有，即非抽象方法）。

items.source:
Visits a local variable instruction. A local variable instruction is an instruction that loads
or stores the value of a local variable.
items.translation: 访问局部变量指令。局部变量指令是指加载或存储局部变量值的指令。

items.source:
Visits a field instruction. A field instruction is an instruction that loads or stores the
value of a field of an object.
items.translation: 访问字段指令。字段指令是指加载或存储对象字段值的指令。

items.source:
Visits a jump instruction. A jump instruction is an instruction that may jump to another
instruction.
items.translation: 访问跳转指令。跳转指令是指可能跳转到另一条指令的指令。

items.source: Visits a label. A label designates the instruction that will be visited just after it.
items.translation: 访问标签。标签指定紧随其后的将被访问的指令。

items.source:
Visits the end of the method. This method, which is the last one to be called, is used to
inform the visitor that all the annotations and attributes of the method have been visited.
items.translation: 访问方法的末尾。此方法是最后被调用的方法，用于通知访客该方法的注解和属性均已访问完毕。

items.source: typeRef - a reference to the annotated type. The sort of this type reference must be TypeReference.INSTANCEOF, TypeReference.NEW, TypeReference.CONSTRUCTOR_REFERENCE, TypeReference.METHOD_REFERENCE, TypeReference.CAST, TypeReference.CONSTRUCTOR_INVOCATION_TYPE_ARGUMENT, TypeReference.METHOD_INVOCATION_TYPE_ARGUMENT, TypeReference.CONSTRUCTOR_REFERENCE_TYPE_ARGUMENT, or TypeReference.METHOD_REFERENCE_TYPE_ARGUMENT. See TypeReference.
items.translation: typeRef - 对已注解类型的引用。此类型引用的类型必须为TypeReference.INSTANCEOF、TypeReference.NEW、TypeReference.CONSTRUCTOR_REFERENCE、TypeReference.METHOD_REFERENCE、TypeReference.CAST、TypeReference.CONSTRUCTOR_INVOCATION_TYPE_ARGUMENT、TypeReference.METHOD_INVOCATION_TYPE_ARGUMENT、TypeReference.CONSTRUCTOR_REFERENCE_TYPE_ARGUMENT或TypeReference.METHOD_REFERENCE_TYPE_ARGUMENT。参见TypeReference。

items.source:
operand - the operand of the instruction to be visited.
When opcode is BIPUSH, operand value should be between Byte.MIN_VALUE and Byte.MAX_VALUE.
When opcode is SIPUSH, operand value should be between Short.MIN_VALUE and Short.MAX_VALUE.
When opcode is NEWARRAY, operand value should be one of Opcodes.T_BOOLEAN, Opcodes.T_CHAR, Opcodes.T_FLOAT, Opcodes.T_DOUBLE, Opcodes.T_BYTE, Opcodes.T_SHORT, Opcodes.T_INT or Opcodes.T_LONG.
items.translation:
operand - 要访问的指令的操作数。
当 opcode 为 BIPUSH 时，操作数值应在 Byte.MIN_VALUE 和 Byte.MAX_VALUE 之间。
当 opcode 为 SIPUSH 时，操作数值应在 Short.MIN_VALUE 和 Short.MAX_VALUE 之间。
当 opcode 为 NEWARRAY 时，操作数值应为 Opcodes.T_BOOLEAN、Opcodes.T_CHAR、Opcodes.T_FLOAT、Opcodes.T_DOUBLE、Opcodes.T_BYTE、 Opcodes.T_SHORT、Opcodes.T_INT 或 Opcodes.T_LONG 之一。

items.source: value - the constant to be loaded on the stack. This parameter must be a non null Integer, a Float, a Long, a Double, a String, a Type of OBJECT or ARRAY sort for .class constants, for classes whose version is 49, a Type of METHOD sort for MethodType, a Handle for MethodHandle constants, for classes whose version is 51 or a ConstantDynamic for a constant dynamic for classes whose version is 55.
items.translation: value - 要加载到栈上的常量。此参数必须是非 null 的 Integer、Float、Long、Double、String，对于 .class 常量，为 OBJECT 或 ARRAY 排序的 Type（适用于版本为 49 的类），METHOD 排序的 Type（用于 MethodType），Handle（用于 MethodHandle 常量，适用于版本为 51 的类），或 ConstantDynamic（用于版本为 55 的类的常量动态）。

items.source: local - the local variable types in this frame. This array must not be modified. Primitive types are represented by Opcodes.TOP, Opcodes.INTEGER, Opcodes.FLOAT, Opcodes.LONG, Opcodes.DOUBLE, Opcodes.NULL or Opcodes.UNINITIALIZED_THIS (long and double are represented by a single element). Reference types are represented by String objects (representing internal names, see Type.getInternalName()), and uninitialized types by Label objects (this label designates the NEW instruction that created this uninitialized value).
items.translation: local - 此帧中的局部变量类型。不得修改此数组。基本类型由 Opcodes.TOP、Opcodes.INTEGER、Opcodes.FLOAT、Opcodes.LONG、Opcodes.DOUBLE、Opcodes.NULL 或 Opcodes.UNINITIALIZED_THIS 表示（long 和 double 由单个元素表示）。引用类型由 String 对象表示（表示内部名称，见 Type.getInternalName()），未初始化类型由 Label 对象表示（此标签指定创建该未初始化值的 NEW 指令）。

items.source: bootstrapMethodArguments - the bootstrap method constant arguments. Each argument must be an Integer, Float, Long, Double, String, Type, Handle or ConstantDynamic value. This method is allowed to modify the content of the array so a caller should expect that this array may change.
items.translation: bootstrapMethodArguments - 引导方法常量参数。每个参数必须是 Integer、Float、Long、Double、String、Type、Handle 或 ConstantDynamic 类型的值。此方法允许修改数组的内容，因此调用者应预期该数组可能会发生变化。

items.source: typeRef - a reference to the annotated type. The sort of this type reference must be TypeReference.METHOD_TYPE_PARAMETER, TypeReference.METHOD_TYPE_PARAMETER_BOUND, TypeReference.METHOD_RETURN, TypeReference.METHOD_RECEIVER, TypeReference.METHOD_FORMAL_PARAMETER or TypeReference.THROWS. See TypeReference.
items.translation: typeRef - 对已注解类型的引用。此类型引用的种类必须是TypeReference.METHOD_TYPE_PARAMETER、TypeReference.METHOD_TYPE_PARAMETER_BOUND、TypeReference.METHOD_RETURN、TypeReference.METHOD_RECEIVER、TypeReference.METHOD_FORMAL_PARAMETER或TypeReference.THROWS。参见TypeReference。

items.source: type - the type of this stack map frame. Must be Opcodes.F_NEW for expanded frames, or Opcodes.F_FULL, Opcodes.F_APPEND, Opcodes.F_CHOP, Opcodes.F_SAME or Opcodes.F_APPEND, Opcodes.F_SAME1 for compressed frames.
items.translation: type - 此堆栈映射帧的类型。对于扩展帧，必须是Opcodes.F_NEW；对于压缩帧，必须是Opcodes.F_FULL、Opcodes.F_APPEND、Opcodes.F_CHOP、Opcodes.F_SAME或Opcodes.F_APPEND、Opcodes.F_SAME1。

items.source: typeRef - a reference to the annotated type. The sort of this type reference must be TypeReference.LOCAL_VARIABLE or TypeReference.RESOURCE_VARIABLE. See TypeReference.
items.translation: typeRef - 对已注解类型的引用。此类型引用的类型必须是TypeReference.LOCAL_VARIABLE或TypeReference.RESOURCE_VARIABLE。参见TypeReference。

items.source: access - the parameter's access flags, only ACC_FINAL, ACC_SYNTHETIC or/and ACC_MANDATED are allowed (see Opcodes).
items.translation: access - 参数的访问标志，仅允许 ACC_FINAL、ACC_SYNTHETIC 和/或 ACC_MANDATED（参见Opcodes）。

items.source: api - the ASM API version implemented by this visitor. Must be one of the ASMx values in Opcodes.
items.translation: api - 此访问者实现的 ASM API 版本。必须是Opcodes中的某个x值，例如 ASMx。

items.source: typeRef - a reference to the annotated type. The sort of this type reference must be TypeReference.EXCEPTION_PARAMETER. See TypeReference.
items.translation: typeRef - 对已注解类型的引用。此类型引用的类型必须是TypeReference.EXCEPTION_PARAMETER。参见TypeReference。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if start has not already been visited by this visitor (by the visitLabel(Label) method).
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果此访问者尚未通过 visitLabel(Label) 方法访问过 start。

items.source: parameter - the parameter index. This index must be strictly smaller than the number of parameters in the method descriptor, and strictly smaller than the parameter count specified in visitAnnotableParameterCount(int, boolean). Important note: a parameter index i is not required to correspond to the i'th parameter descriptor in the method descriptor, in particular in case of synthetic parameters (see https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jvms/se9/html/jvms-4.html#jvms-4.7.18).
items.translation: parameter - 参数索引。该索引必须严格小于方法描述符中的参数数量，且严格小于在 visitAnnotableParameterCount(int, boolean) 中指定的参数计数。重要提示：参数索引 i 并不要求与方法描述符中的第 i 个参数描述符相对应，特别是在存在合成参数的情况下（参见 https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jvms/se9/html/jvms-4.html#jvms-4.7.18）。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if one of the labels has already been visited by this visitor (by the visitLabel(Label) method).
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果其中一个标签已被此访问者访问过（通过 visitLabel(Label) 方法）。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if one of the labels has not already been visited by this visitor (by the visitLabel(Label) method).
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果其中一个标签尚未被此访问者（通过 visitLabel(Label) 方法）访问过。

items.source: type - the operand of the instruction to be visited. This operand must be the internal name of an object or array class (see Type.getInternalName()).
items.translation: `type` - 要访问的指令的操作数。此操作数必须是对象或数组类的内部名称（参见Type.getInternalName()）。

items.source: owner - the internal name of the method's owner class (see Type.getInternalName()).
items.translation: owner - 方法所有者类的内部名称（参见Type.getInternalName()）。

items.source: labels - beginnings of the handler blocks. labels[i] is the beginning of the handler block for the min + i key.
items.translation: `labels` - 处理程序块的起始位置。labels[i] 是 `min + i` 键对应的处理程序块的起始位置。

items.source: labels - beginnings of the handler blocks. labels[i] is the beginning of the handler block for the keys[i] key.
items.translation: `labels` - 处理程序块的开头。`labels[i]` 是 `keys[i]` 键对应的处理程序块的开头。

items.source: descriptor - an array type descriptor (see Type).
items.translation: descriptor - 一个数组类型描述符（参见Type）。

items.source: type - the internal name of the type of exceptions handled by the handler (see Type.getInternalName()), or null to catch any exceptions (for "finally" blocks).
items.translation: type - 由该处理器处理的异常类型的内部名称（参见 Type.getInternalName()），或为 null 以捕获任何异常（用于"finally"块）。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if a frame is visited just after another one, without any instruction between the two (unless this frame is a Opcodes#F_SAME frame, in which case it is silently ignored).
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果在一个帧之后立即访问另一个帧，且两者之间没有任何指令（除非该帧是 Opcodes#F_SAME 帧，在这种情况下会被静默忽略）。

items.source: methodVisitor - the method visitor to which this visitor must delegate method calls. May be null.
items.translation: methodVisitor - 此访问者必须向其委派方法调用的方法访问者。可为 null。

items.source: name - parameter name or null if none is provided.
items.translation: name - 参数名称，如果未提供则为 null。

items.source: parameterCount - the number of method parameters than can have annotations. This number must be less or equal than the number of parameter types in the method descriptor. It can be strictly less when a method has synthetic parameters and when these parameters are ignored when computing parameter indices for the purpose of parameter annotations (see https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jvms/se9/html/jvms-4.html#jvms-4.7.18).
items.translation: parameterCount - 可以具有注解的方法参数数量。该数字必须小于或等于方法描述符中的参数类型数量。当方法具有合成参数，并且在计算用于参数注解的参数索引时忽略这些参数时，它可以严格小于该数量（参见 https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jvms/se9/html/jvms-4.html#jvms-4.7.18）。

items.source: visible - true to define the number of method parameters that can have annotations visible at runtime, false to define the number of method parameters that can have annotations invisible at runtime.
items.translation: visible - 设为 true 以定义运行时可见的注解的方法参数数量，设为 false 以定义运行时不可见的注解的方法参数数量。

items.source: numLocal - the number of local variables in the visited frame. Long and double values count for one variable.
items.translation: numLocal - 访问帧中的局部变量数量。long 和 double 值各计为一个变量。

items.source: numStack - the number of operand stack elements in the visited frame. Long and double values count for one stack element.
items.translation: numStack - 已访问帧中操作数栈元素的数量。Long 和 double 值各计为一个栈元素。

items.source: stack - the operand stack types in this frame. This array must not be modified. Its content has the same format as the "local" array.
items.translation: stack - 此帧中的操作数栈类型。此数组不得被修改。其内容与"local"数组的格式相同。

items.source: opcode - the opcode of the instruction to be visited. This opcode is either NOP, ACONST_NULL, ICONST_M1, ICONST_0, ICONST_1, ICONST_2, ICONST_3, ICONST_4, ICONST_5, LCONST_0, LCONST_1, FCONST_0, FCONST_1, FCONST_2, DCONST_0, DCONST_1, IALOAD, LALOAD, FALOAD, DALOAD, AALOAD, BALOAD, CALOAD, SALOAD, IASTORE, LASTORE, FASTORE, DASTORE, AASTORE, BASTORE, CASTORE, SASTORE, POP, POP2, DUP, DUP_X1, DUP_X2, DUP2, DUP2_X1, DUP2_X2, SWAP, IADD, LADD, FADD, DADD, ISUB, LSUB, FSUB, DSUB, IMUL, LMUL, FMUL, DMUL, IDIV, LDIV, FDIV, DDIV, IREM, LREM, FREM, DREM, INEG, LNEG, FNEG, DNEG, ISHL, LSHL, ISHR, LSHR, IUSHR, LUSHR, IAND, LAND, IOR, LOR, IXOR, LXOR, I2L, I2F, I2D, L2I, L2F, L2D, F2I, F2L, F2D, D2I, D2L, D2F, I2B, I2C, I2S, LCMP, FCMPL, FCMPG, DCMPL, DCMPG, IRETURN, LRETURN, FRETURN, DRETURN, ARETURN, RETURN, ARRAYLENGTH, ATHROW, MONITORENTER, or MONITOREXIT.
items.translation: opcode - 要访问的指令的操作码。此操作码可以是 NOP、ACONST_NULL、ICONST_M1、ICONST_0、ICONST_1、ICONST_2、ICONST_3、ICONST_4、ICONST_5、LCONST_0、LCONST_1、FCONST_0、FCONST_1、FCONST_2、DCONST_0、DCONST_1、IALOAD、LALOAD、FALOAD、DALOAD、AALOAD、BALOAD、CALOAD、SALOAD、IASTORE、LASTORE、FASTORE、DASTORE、AASTORE、BASTORE、CASTORE、SASTORE、POP、POP2、DUP、DUP_X1、DUP_X2、DUP2、DUP2_X1、DUP2_X2、SWAP、IADD、LADD、FADD、DADD、ISUB、LSUB、FSUB、DSUB、IMUL、LMUL、FMUL、DMUL、IDIV、LDIV、FDIV、DDIV、IREM、LREM、FREM、DREM、INEG、LNEG、FNEG、DNEG、ISHL、LSHL、ISHR、LSHR、IUSHR、LUSHR、IAND、LAND、IOR、LOR、IXOR、LXOR、I2L、I2F、I2D、L2I、L2F、L2D、F2I、F2L、F2D、D2I、D2L、D2F、I2B、I2C、I2S、LCMP、FCMPL、FCMPG、DCMPL、DCMPG、IRETURN、LRETURN、FRETURN、DRETURN、ARETURN、RETURN、ARRAYLENGTH、ATHROW、MONITORENTER 或 MONITOREXIT。

items.source: opcode - the opcode of the instruction to be visited. This opcode is either BIPUSH, SIPUSH or NEWARRAY.
items.translation: opcode - 待访问指令的操作码。此操作码为 BIPUSH、SIPUSH 或 NEWARRAY 之一。

items.source: opcode - the opcode of the local variable instruction to be visited. This opcode is either ILOAD, LLOAD, FLOAD, DLOAD, ALOAD, ISTORE, LSTORE, FSTORE, DSTORE, ASTORE or RET.
items.translation: opcode - 待访问的局部变量指令的操作码。此操作码为 ILOAD、LLOAD、FLOAD、DLOAD、ALOAD、ISTORE、LSTORE、FSTORE、DSTORE、ASTORE 或 RET 之一。

items.source: varIndex - the operand of the instruction to be visited. This operand is the index of a local variable.
items.translation: varIndex - 要访问的指令的操作数。此操作数是局部变量的索引。

items.source: opcode - the opcode of the type instruction to be visited. This opcode is either NEW, ANEWARRAY, CHECKCAST or INSTANCEOF.
items.translation: opcode - 待访问的类型指令的 opcode。该 opcode 为 NEW、ANEWARRAY、CHECKCAST 或 INSTANCEOF 之一。

items.source: opcode - the opcode of the type instruction to be visited. This opcode is either GETSTATIC, PUTSTATIC, GETFIELD or PUTFIELD.
items.translation: opcode - 要访问的类型指令的操作码。此操作码为 GETSTATIC、PUTSTATIC、GETFIELD 或 PUTFIELD 之一。

items.source: isInterface - if the method's owner class is an interface.
items.translation: isInterface - 如果方法的所有者是接口。

items.source: opcode - the opcode of the type instruction to be visited. This opcode is either IFEQ, IFNE, IFLT, IFGE, IFGT, IFLE, IF_ICMPEQ, IF_ICMPNE, IF_ICMPLT, IF_ICMPGE, IF_ICMPGT, IF_ICMPLE, IF_ACMPEQ, IF_ACMPNE, GOTO, JSR, IFNULL or IFNONNULL.
items.translation: opcode - 待访问的类型指令的操作码。此操作码为 IFEQ、IFNE、IFLT、IFGE、IFGT、IFLE、IF_ICMPEQ、IF_ICMPNE、IF_ICMPLT、IF_ICMPGE、IF_ICMPGT、IF_ICMPLE、IF_ACMPEQ、IF_ACMPNE、GOTO、JSR、IFNULL 或 IFNONNULL 之一。

items.source: label - the operand of the instruction to be visited. This operand is a label that designates the instruction to which the jump instruction may jump.
items.translation: label - 要访问的指令的操作数。此操作数是指定跳转指令可能跳转到的指令的标签。

items.source: varIndex - index of the local variable to be incremented.
items.translation: varIndex - 要递增的局部变量的索引。

items.source: increment - amount to increment the local variable by.
items.translation: increment - 用于增加局部变量的增量。

items.source: min - the minimum key value.
items.translation: min - 最小键值。

items.source: max - the maximum key value.
items.translation: max - 最大键值。

items.source: keys - the values of the keys. Keys must be sorted in increasing order.
items.translation: keys - 键的值。键必须按升序排序。

items.source: numDimensions - the number of dimensions of the array to allocate.
items.translation: numDimensions - 要分配的数组的维度数。

items.source: start - the beginning of the exception handler's scope (inclusive).
items.translation: start - 异常处理程序作用域的起始点（包含在内）。

items.source: end - the end of the exception handler's scope (exclusive).
items.translation: end - 异常处理程序作用域的结束（不包含）。

items.source: handler - the beginning of the exception handler's code.
items.translation: handler - 异常处理代码的开头。

items.source: name - the name of a local variable.
items.translation: name - 局部变量的名称。

items.source: descriptor - the type descriptor of this local variable.
items.translation: descriptor - 此局部变量的类型描述符。

items.source: signature - the type signature of this local variable. May be null if the local variable type does not use generic types.
items.translation: signature - 此局部变量的类型签名。如果局部变量类型不使用泛型，则可能为 null。

items.source: start - the first instruction corresponding to the scope of this local variable (inclusive).
items.translation: start - 对应此局部变量作用域（包含）的第一条指令。

items.source: end - the last instruction corresponding to the scope of this local variable (exclusive).
items.translation: end - 对应于该局部变量作用域的最后一条指令（不包含）。

items.source: index - the local variable's index.
items.translation: index - 局部变量的索引。

items.source: start - the fist instructions corresponding to the continuous ranges that make the scope of this local variable (inclusive).
items.translation: start - 对应于构成此局部变量作用域（包含在内）的连续范围的首条指令。

items.source: end - the last instructions corresponding to the continuous ranges that make the scope of this local variable (exclusive). This array must have the same size as the 'start' array.
items.translation: `end` - 对应于构成此局部变量作用域（不包含）的连续范围的最后指令。此数组的大小必须与 `start` 数组相同。

items.source: index - the local variable's index in each range. This array must have the same size as the 'start' array.
items.translation: index - 每个范围内局部变量的索引。此数组的大小必须与 'start' 数组相同。

items.source: line - a line number. This number refers to the source file from which the class was compiled.
items.translation: line - 行号。该数字指代编译该类时使用的源文件。

items.source: start - the first instruction corresponding to this line number.
items.translation: start - 对应此行号的第一个指令。

items.source: maxStack - maximum stack size of the method.
items.translation: maxStack - 方法的最大堆栈大小。

items.source: maxLocals - maximum number of local variables for the method.
items.translation: maxLocals - 方法的最大局部变量数。

items.source:
the method visitor to which this visitor must delegate method calls, or 
    null.
items.translation: 该访问者必须委托方法调用的方法，或为 null。

items.source:
a visitor to the visit the actual default value of this annotation interface method, or
    null if this visitor is not interested in visiting this default value. The
    'name' parameters passed to the methods of this annotation visitor are ignored. Moreover,
    exactly one visit method must be called on this annotation visitor, followed by visitEnd.
items.translation: 访问者可以访问此注解接口方法的实际默认值，或者如果此访问者不感兴趣访问该默认值，则为 null。传递给此注解访问者方法的 'name' 参数将被忽略。此外，必须恰好调用一次此注解访问者的 visit 方法，随后调用 visitEnd。

items.source: The ASM API version implemented by this visitor. The value of this field must be one of the ASMx values in Opcodes.
items.translation: 此访问者实现的 ASM API 版本。该字段的值必须是Opcodes中的ASMx值之一。

items.source: The ASM API version implemented by this visitor.
items.translation: 此访问者实现的 ASM API 版本。

items.source: Visits the number of method parameters that can have annotations.
items.translation: 访问可以具有注解的方法参数的数量。

items.translation: 访问方法的末尾。

items.source: Visits a field instruction.
items.translation: 访问字段指令。

items.source: Visits the current state of the local variables and operand stack elements.
items.translation: 访问当前局部变量和运算子栈元素的状态。

items.source: Visits an annotation on an instruction.
items.translation: 访问指令上的注解。

items.source: Visits a jump instruction.
items.translation: 访问跳转指令。

items.source: Visits a label.
items.translation: 访问标签。

items.source: Visits a LDC instruction.
items.translation: 访问 LDC 指令。

items.source: Visits a method instruction.
items.translation: 访问方法指令。

items.source: Visits an annotation on an exception handler type.
items.translation: 访问异常处理器类型上的注解。

items.source: Visits a type instruction.
items.translation: 访问类型指令。

items.source: Visits a local variable instruction.
items.translation: 访问局部变量指令。

items.source: owner - the internal name of the field's owner class (see Type.getInternalName()).
items.translation: owner - 字段所有者类的内部名称（参见Type.getInternalName()）。

items.source: descriptor - the field's descriptor (see Type).
items.translation: descriptor - 字段的描述符（参见Type）。

items.source: attribute - an attribute.
items.translation: attribute - 一个属性。

items.source: name - the field's name.
items.translation: name - 字段的名称。

items.source: bootstrapMethodHandle - the bootstrap method.
items.translation: bootstrapMethodHandle - 引导方法。
